Name: Luau Beach Tilesheet Retexture
Author: TheNightAttack300
Description:
A simple joke retexture that replaces the watery waves on the Beach (and some other locations) with Luau soup (or atleast how I try). The mod also adds tidbits relating to the Luau soup (like ingredients and such).

It's my first mod, but I start small anyways.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ before the tilesheet replacement can function.
To install: the Luau Beach folder inside the zip file must be unpacked inside the "Mods" folder.

Made for the SDV End of Summer 2020 Event hosted on the official SDV Discord with the theme of "Waves". Though to be honest, this mod is a bit lazy at best, but no one tried this idea before, so here I go.

I do not plan to update this mod anytime in the future, unless if anything breaks apart.

Credits to anyone (few people) who can help me make this mod.
